result.title: Simultaneously Boosting Efficiency and Capability for Linear Attention via Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification
result.summary: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出在 linear attention 的 QKV 投影中嵌入自适应通道压缩与激活纯化（ACCAP）机制，配以聚焦核函数与自门控，构造轻量线性注意力模块，在降低参数与 FLOPs 的同时提升 ViT 分类精度与跨架构兼容性。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文主题是 ViT 线性注意力的效率—能力折中与 ImageNet 分类表现，不涉及推理期状态生成、视觉证据筛选、停止决策或答案对内部表示的使用，通道压缩线索也停留在架构效率层面，与 LVR 的表示与推理机制缺少实质联系。
